geography: Worldwide (sold as Maviret outside the U.S.)
moa: HCV NS3/4A protease inhibitor (glecaprevir) plus NS5A inhibitor (pibrentasvir)
series_start_reason: Series starts 2017Q3, the launch quarter (FDA approval 2017-08-03). AbbVie's filings for 2017Q3-2018Q2 print only a combined 'HCV' row, so those quarters are read from later AbbVie filings: the prior-year columns of the 10-Qs for September 2018 (2017Q3: 95; nine months 2017: 95), March 2019 (2018Q1: 848) and June 2019 (2018Q2: 932), and full-year 2017 (490) from the 2018 10-K, less the nine months, for 2017Q4.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms, incl. 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K) for CIK 0001551152 (AbbVie), 0000001800 (Abbott), 0001578845 (Allergan plc / Actavis plc), 0000855654 (ImmunoGen) and 0000850693 (Allergan, Inc.) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (scripts/list_filings.py); earnings 8-Ks selected by item 2.02 (also item 12 / 7,9 for 2003-2004 Abbott and Allergan, Inc. filings), exhibits resolved from each filing's index.json (scripts/earnings.py, exhibits.py).

Product rows pulled by table-row parsing of each earnings exhibit (scripts/abbvie_extract.py, abbott_extract.py, allergan_extract.py, allerganinc_extract.py); the quarter of an AbbVie block is read from the document's own '% Change vs. nQyy' header row; every series was checked for gaps and, where the Q4 release prints a full-year figure, quarters were summed against it (scripts/build_all.py).

Searched the 2017Q2-2018Q2 10-Qs and FY2017 10-K full text: MAVYRET appears only in narrative text; first revenue row 2018Q3 (U.S. 444, Int'l. 395, Total 839). 2019-2025 quarters sum to the printed full-year figures.

[g4_us extension 2026-11] Listed AbbVie (CIK 1551152) 8-K item 2.02, 10-Q and 10-K filings 2016-04 to 2019-09 via data.sec.gov submissions and read every table row of each 8-K Exhibit 99.1, 10-Q and 10-K: the filings for 2017Q3-2018Q2 print only a combined 'HCV' row, but the 10-Qs from the September 2018 10-Q on carry a revenues-by-product note with prior-year columns (MAVYRET / United States / International / Total).

Added 2017Q3 (prior-year column, Sept 2018 10-Q: Total 839 | 95 | 2,619 | 95), 2017Q4 (FY2017 490 in the 2018 10-K less nine months 2017 95 = 395), 2018Q1 (prior-year column, March 2019 10-Q: 790 | 848) and 2018Q2 (prior-year column, June 2019 10-Q: 780 | 932 | 1,570 | 1,780).

Checks: 2018Q1 848 + 2018Q2 932 = 1,780, the six months 2018 printed in the June 2019 10-Q; 2018 quarters 848 + 932 + 839 + 819 = 3,438, the full-year 2018 Total in the 2018 10-K; nine months 2017 equals 2017Q3 (95 = 95), consistent with the August 2017 approval, and the 2018 10-K prints 2016 as a dash.

launch_evidence.quote: These factors were partially offset by the launch of MAVYRET in certain geographies during the third quarter of 2017.
